implementation_capability.note: wood returns void and the difference is an IO effect.  Issue #109 adds no IO proof model, so the checker is not expected to prove NOT_EQ here; the relation is not weakened to match that.  The only assertion made from it is that EQUIVALENT is forbidden

native_execution_witness.command: gcc -O0 -std=c11 probe_<version>.c -lm && ./probe_<version> | wc -c  # one program per version, because the observable is stdout

source_witness.left_observation: new wood writes "Solved Wood constraint\n" to stdout
source_witness.right_observation: old wood writes nothing to stdout

verification_basis: source review of both versions plus an independent native execution of the two definitions on the recorded input; the verdict and the same evidence are registered in the tsv, which is the source of truth
verified_by: Issue #109 PR-109-B (source review + independent native execution)
